title: Start: Teams message
description: Starts the work for each message POSTed to http://127.0.0.1:PORT/message as {from, chat, text}. Messages not matching the filter are dropped before any run exists.

fields.name: secret
fields.label: Listener secret (optional)
fields.help: When set, requests must send it as header X-Hook-Secret or ?key=. Usually comes from the Teams credential set.

fields.name: chat
fields.label: Only in this chat (exact name, empty = any)
